title: Nebuchadnezzar's Dream
hint: World Empires from a Prophetic Perspective
intro: King Nebuchadnezzar dreamed of a great statue. Daniel interpreted it as a prophecy about four world empires that would arise before God establishes His eternal kingdom.

items.title: Head of Gold
items.text: You, O king, are the king of kings... You are the head of gold. Babylon (605–539 BC) under Nebuchadnezzar.

items.title: Chest and Arms of Silver
items.text: After you, another kingdom will arise, inferior to yours. Medo-Persia (539–331 BC).

items.title: Belly and Thighs of Bronze
items.text: A third kingdom, made of bronze, will rule over all the earth. Greece under Alexander the Great (331–168 BC).

items.title: Legs of Iron
items.text: A fourth kingdom will be as strong as iron. Just as iron crushes everything, it will break and shatter all things. The Roman Empire (168 BC–AD 476).

items.title: Feet of Iron and Clay
items.text: The feet were partly of iron and partly of clay. The kingdom will be divided—partly strong, partly weak.

items.title: The Stone
items.text: A stone was cut out without hands and crushed the statue. The stone became a great mountain that filled the whole earth. God's eternal kingdom.
